Frequently Asked Questions

Looking for answers about HVAC services in Ontario?

Explore our FAQ section to learn about HVAC repair, installation costs, maintenance, and how to choose a reliable HVAC contractor near you. LG Home Comfort helps homeowners make smart decisions.

How do I find a reliable HVAC contractor near me in Ontario?

Look for a licensed and insured HVAC contractor with positive customer reviews, certified technicians, and reliable support. LG Home Comfort provides certified HVAC services and 24/7 customer support across Ontario.

Does LG Home Comfort offer 24/7 emergency HVAC support?

Yes. LG Home Comfort provides 24/7 telephone support. Call us anytime, and our team will assess your situation and help arrange the appropriate service.

 1-866-438-5442

Does LG Home Comfort service all make and models of HVAC equipment?

Yes, LG Home Comfort’s certified technicians service, repair, and maintain all makes and models of  furnaces, central air conditioners,  heat pumps, boilers, and water heaters across Ontario, regardless of the brand or age of your existing equipment.

We are also an authorized installer and dealer for a wide range of industry-leading brands, including Carrier, Lennox, Trane, Navien, Rinnai, Noritz, Aprilaire, AO Smith, Bradford White, Ecobee, Midea, Gree, Excalibur, Kholer and more.

Whether your system is a 20-year-old unit that needs expert repair or a brand-new high-efficiency installation, our technicians arrive equipped with the parts and training to get the job done right the first time.

 1-866-438-5442

Is a Heat Pump or Furnace Better for an Ontario Home?

A cold-climate heat pump is an energy-efficient option for heating and cooling an Ontario home. Some models can operate at temperatures as low as −30°C (−22°F).

For added comfort during extreme cold, a hybrid system combines a heat pump with a gas furnace. The heat pump handles moderate temperatures, while the furnace provides backup heating when needed.

Eligible systems may qualify for Ontario’s Home Renovation Savings Program. Eligibility depends on the home, equipment and current program requirements.

Call LG Home Comfort at 1-866-438-5442 to compare your options.

What does an annual HVAC maintenance plan include, and is it worth the cost?

A standard annual HVAC maintenance plan from LG Home Comfort includes a fall furnace tune-up (heat exchanger inspection, burner cleaning, flue check, filter replacement, safety controls test) and a spring AC tune-up (coil cleaning, refrigerant level check, electrical inspection, drain flush). Plans also include priority emergency dispatch, discounted service call fees, and documentation required to maintain manufacturer warranties.

Research consistently shows that annual maintenance reduces the likelihood of a mid-season breakdown by over 60% and extends equipment lifespan by 3-5 years  delivering significant long-term savings compared to the plan cost.

Is LG Home Comfort licensed and insured in Ontario?

Yes. LG Home Comfort is  fully licensed, insured, and  TSSA-certified to perform HVAC installations, repairs, and maintenance across Ontario. All our technicians hold the required TSSA (Technical Standards and Safety Authority) certification and carry full liability insurance, so every job is completed safely, professionally, and in full compliance with Ontario building codes.

 1-866-438-5442

How can I report a service concern or complaint?

LG Home Comfort offers 24/7 customer support. If you have a concern about your service, contact our team directly at 1-866-438-5442 and provide your service details and a clear description of the issue so we can review your concern and determine the appropriate next steps.

Does LG Home Comfort also provide home security solutions in Ontario?

Yes. In addition to heating, cooling, water heating, indoor air quality, and water purification services, LG Home Comfort also provides professionally installed home security solutions for homeowners across Ontario. As a Canadian, family-run company, we support both home comfort and security needs with clear recommendations, professional installation, dependable support, and 24/7 customer support when assistance is needed.
